# Agentic research assistant

*Client industry: finance | Completed: 2024-08-19 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p15*

## The problem
The client was an investment analyst compiling company briefs.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, a stateful multi-step agent graph, answers grounded in retrieved company documents, Pinecone. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project turned a 2-hour brief into a 15-minute review.
